description_en: Updates the information of a Prometheus instance
kebab_example: aliyun arms update-prometheus-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id vpc-xxx --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdatePrometheusInstance

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID of the Prometheus instance
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The data retention period, in days
parameters.name: storage_duration

parameters.help_en: The number of days for automatic archiving after storage expires. Valid values: 60, 90, 180, and 365. A value of 0 indicates no archiving
parameters.help_zh: 存储到期后，自动归档保存的天数（可选值：60、90、180、365）。0表示不归档保存
parameters.name: archive_duration

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable access token authentication
parameters.name: enable_auth_token

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable authentication-free read
parameters.name: enable_auth_free_read

parameters.help_en: The list of IP addresses for authentication-free read. CIDR notation is supported. Separate multiple IP addresses with line feeds
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启免密读的IP地址列表，支持CIDR配置。多个IP之间换行符分隔
parameters.name: auth_free_read_policy

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable authentication-free write
parameters.name: enable_auth_free_write

parameters.help_en: The list of IP addresses for authentication-free write. CIDR notation is supported. Separate multiple IP addresses with line feeds
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启免密写的IP地址列表，支持CIDR配置。多个IP之间换行符分隔
parameters.name: auth_free_write_policy

parameters.help_en:
The billing method. Valid values:
POSTPAY: Pay-as-you-go based on metric reporting volume.
POSTPAY_GB: Pay-as-you-go based on metric write volume
parameters.help_zh:
计费方式：
POSTPAY：按指标上报量后付费。
POSTPAY_GB：按指标写入量后付费
parameters.name: payment_type

Code.description_en: The status code. A value of 200 indicates success. Other values indicate errors
Code.description_zh: 状态码。200为成功，其他状态码为异常

Data.description_en: The description of the operation result

Message.description_en: The message returned for the request
